title: iPhone free for 25 min while 1 job waits

messages.text:
The iPhone has had no holder for 25 min (since 09:08Z; released by ts-thermal-own). The limit is 5 min.
Waiting on the status board: device-plan (owner lead; startable: P-130).
What unblocks it: the next owner takes it (node tools/lock.mjs acquire iphone --owner <you> ...).
No steward on duty (mgmt-devices is parked): the lead handles this thread (I-175).
One message per idle period; this thread closes by itself when the slot is taken (tools/idle.mjs, I-105).

False alarm: the phone is free on purpose; both waiting phone tests need the Serious heat condition back first.
- The next phone test (P-129) and the one after it (P-130) are staged and checked; neither can start at the wrong heat.
- My board row now says it waits on your Xcode heat step (C-065), so the alarm is clear.
What you need to do: start Serious in Xcode and press Done on that step (C-065).
